verdict.rationale: Superset is documented as local-first: it works offline, keeps code on your machine, and the CLI manages a "local host server" that drives the same backend as the desktop app. A public GitHub repo also exists. However, nothing explicitly documents self-hosting the full product, and the sync, MCP and API services run on Superset's hosted infrastructure (api.superset.sh). Missing for 10: explicit self-hosting docs or guide, evidence that the sync/API/MCP backend can be self-hosted, an open-source license statement, and independent hands-on reports of self-hosting.
